claims.statement: NodeViewToggle is a StereoModeToggle-style 80x36 two-segment gallery|node control (kViewTiles / kViewNodes icons, help key nodeViewToggle, setNodeView + onToggle callbacks) inserted LEFT of the preset bar in PluginHeader; the header seeds it from services_.prefs.getBool(UiPrefs::kNodeView, false) at construction.

The view choice persists as a plain UiPrefs key UiPrefs::kNodeView = "t3k.nodeView" (UiPrefs.h:68; stored as "true"/"false" strings, default false = gallery): PluginRoot::onNodeViewToggle writes prefs.setBool(kNodeView, nodeView) and calls main_.chainScreen().setView(nodeView).

ChainScreen grows a third view branch: setView(bool) hides the gallery and shows the node view (and back); the node view has NO DragScroller — ChainScreen::scroller() keeps returning gallery_.scroller() even while the node view is visible; closeDetail() restores whichever view nodeView_ says the user was in.
The node-view ticket added Help keys + entries: nodeViewToggle, nodeView, nodeEmptySlot, node, nodePower, nodeRemove, nodeMode.

The node view is a second, TOGGLEABLE views layer over the same ChainState the gallery draws (ticket ui-block-interface-draft.md): no new DSP — a slot's contents ARE the existing ChainBlocks re-arranged in ChainState lane order, and every mutation goes back through ChainStore so gallery and node view can never disagree. The old 4x3 snake grid (kColumns=4/kRows=3, 84x60 cells, Grid::slotNearest drops) was replaced 2026-10-15 by the signal-line grid.

The grid is ONE row of 10 slots (Row::kSlotCount = 10, Row::kLabelH = 18 label band under each square, NodeModel.h:34-36); a SECOND row of 10 appears only when the lane exceeds 10 blocks (NodeView::paint/resized compute nCells = 10 + (lane.size() > 10 ? 10 : 0)) so lanes of 10 or fewer render a single row. Cell i = lane item i (1:1 left-lane map); tail cells beyond the lane are EMPTY = a valid bypassed pass-through state (the key difference from the gallery, where every tile is an effect).

Persistence: UiPrefs::kNodeView = "t3k.nodeView" (UiPrefs.h:68) is a plain STRING pref "true"/"false" — UiPrefs::getBool accepts only those two spellings, anything else (including JUCE var::toString()'s "1") falls back to the default false. ChainScreen's ctor reads it and calls setView(true) when set; PluginRoot::onNodeViewToggle (fired by the PluginHeader NodeViewToggle, an 80x36 two-segment gallery|node control, help key nodeViewToggle) writes the pref and forwards to chainScreen().setView(nodeView). ChainScreen::setView hides the gallery / shows the node view; the node view has no DragScroller.

Repaint invariants (bug found in the 2026-10-15 capture hunt — the line stayed invisible for a whole debug session): setNodeView(bool) (NodeView.cpp:460) and chainChanged() (NodeView.cpp:475) both END WITH repaint(), because refresh() only updates the cell children; the body (signal line segments, In/Out labels, strip) must repaint on first-time activation, on lane row gain/loss, and on selection change or the line silently stays absent until an unrelated invalidate.

Grid drag-and-drop (user ruling 2026-10-18): cellDragMove tracks a dragInGrid_ flag from the pointer position vs the grid bounds (rowX_±4, row/row-range ±4) and a g_dropTarget slot (row*10+slot), painting a transparent drop preview on the target cell that disappears when the pointer leaves the grid; cellDragEnd (NodeView.cpp:608) — if the drop lands OUTSIDE the grid (g_dropTarget < 0) it is a no-op: cancelDrag() restores the block to its origin; otherwise the full-lane id list from NodeModel::orderWith(blockId, target) — an erase+insert-at-target splice whose direction is determined by the target slot — is committed through chain.reorderBlocks. Drops commit through the store; a drop back on the origin slot is a no-op permutation.

The node grid's read-side model (plugin/ui/views/nodeview/NodeModel.{h,cpp} — a const view over ChainState: kind table with kind colours, paletteKinds, blockAt/indexOf, and orderWith splice) is exercised headlessly by test/src/node_model_tests.cpp (9 tests: kind table, palette, blockAt/indexOf, orderWith permutation invariance, exact-slot move, same-slot no-op, unknown-id untouched, target clamping, empty-square move). DspTests compiles the real plugin/ui/views/nodeview/NodeModel.cpp + plugin/ui/model/ChainState.cpp (with plugin/ui and plugin/ui/views/nodeview on the include path) so these tests run the real model, not a copy; the full UI remains unlinked by the suite.

Tone (NAM/conv) nodes in batch 2 behave like their kind, not like empty slots: NodeCell::paint treats `!s.has || s.insert` as the dashed+plus gap state only (hover_ || presetEmpty), so an occupied insert paints its kind-coloured border and icon; NodeCell::update sets the help text to the block's own title when s.has (falling back to help::Key::nodeEmptySlot for true gaps — the old hardcoded 'Empty slot — click to add an effect' with its em-dash mojibake is gone); Model marks insert rows with cs.insert=true and their label as 'add' only while the gap hint shows. Clicking a tone node SELECTS it (strip shows In/Out/Mix), it does not open the add menu (user m02657 item 6).

Testbed scenarios for the node view (scenarios.json, as of the 2026-10-17 batch-3 closeout, commit 5b9bdd9): node-main (3-block left lane — compressor selected, chorus, insert — seeds "localStorage": {"t3k.nodeView": "true"}), node-toggle-live (batch 2, click-imitated gallery→node toggle + strip-knob survival), and FIVE batch-3 driven scenarios — node-add-gap (add lands in the mid-lane gap, line stays continuous), node-remove, node-knob-change (knob turn + mode menu), node-drag-drop (cell drag & drop), node-switch-view (gallery↔node switching) — all click-imitated, all jassert-pass. Two landmines: (1) the seed value MUST be the string "true" — Host::seedPrefs does prefs.set(name, value.toString()) and a JSON bool becomes "1", which UiPrefs::getBool rejects (the signal line stayed invisible for the whole 2026-10-15 capture hunt until fixed); (2) UiTestbed --capture <outDir> <scenario> writes PNGs (--selftest does not), --capture auto-iterates all scenarios. The batch-3 drives needed real plumbing: Knob::driveEmit (setValue is face-only; drives need the drag-path emit that fires onChange), Drive::dragTo (multi-point press/travel/release) for the cell drag, and MockBackend add/remove/setParam now mutate the chain so end-state asserts are real. Captures: node-main/*.png (node-add-gap, node-knob-change, node-main, node-remove, node-drag-drop, node-switch-view, node-toggle-live).

Cell paint states (the Q-Cortex/Line 6 transparency law, as of batch 3 / 2026-10-17): an ACTIVE block paints an opaque theme::kSurface fill (the signal line STOPS at its edges) with kind-colour border at full alpha and a white icon; a POWER-OFF block paints NO fill (the line runs THROUGH it) with border at 0.35 alpha and a muted icon; an EMPTY slot is invisible by default — a mid-lane gap is a TRUE gap (continuous line, no square) — EXCEPT on mouse hover, where it fills with an OPAQUE theme::kPanelBg panel + dashed border + plus glyph + 'add' label (batch 3: the opaque fill keeps the signal line from showing through the gap square), or when the whole lane is empty/insert-only (CellState.presetEmpty), which shows the same dashed+plus+add hint. A selected block adds a theme::kHighlight border.

Pointer grammar on a node: a short click selects the block (params load into the strip); a 250 ms hold (kHoldMs = 250) begins a lane drag; motion before the hold cancels the timer; right-click opens the block menu (power toggle, help key nodePower; remove, help key nodeRemove; plus the palette add-menu over Model::paletteKinds()); DOUBLE-CLICK toggles the block's power (NodeCell::mouseDoubleClick -> NodeView::togglePower -> setBlockParam(id, "enabled", 0|1)). Cell hover sets a help text (occupied title, ' (off)' suffix when off, nodeEmptySlot key for true gaps) driving the JUCE tooltip and the bottom hint bar via the HintBus HintTracker. Drags use juce::Component::createComponentSnapshot ghosts; batch 3 (commit 5b9bdd9) changed the ghost to SEMI-TRANSPARENT — Ghost ctor setAlpha(0.6f) so the grid shows through — and the drop-target cell paints the dragged effect's icon at 0.5 alpha inside the theme::kHighlight border (NodeView.cpp g_dropTarget paint block, batch-3 item 8). A suppress-click-until timestamp keeps a drop from firing a stray select.

The convolution node's strip carries an IR preview: pullConvPreview (NodeView.cpp:1139) pulls chain.convPreview(blockId) (envL/envR arrays + length/sampleRate + fade curves, same pattern as the gallery EffectTile::pullConvPreview) into the strip's KernelPlot (convPlot_, views/gallery/KernelPlot at 64 px). Batch 3 (item 6): with NO kernel loaded (null dynamic object) the preview now setVisible(true) with a cleared envelope + the loaded block's fade curves, so the flat plot + 'Load IR…' button lay out and the strip's knobs are no longer clipped. The 'Load IR…' button (loadIr_) calls startConvIrLoader (NodeView.cpp:1169) which launches an async juce::FileChooser (*.wav;*.wave;*.aiff;*.aif) and on OK calls chain.loadConvIr(blockId, file); a g_irLoaderSeq token guard (plus a convIrChooser_ re-entry guard) drops stale chooser results (WeakReference<Component> is private in JUCE 9, so the loader is token-guarded); an 'error' property on the result is toasted.

The signal line (NodeView::paint) draws, per VISIBLE row, 2 px white.withAlpha(0.45f) SEGMENTS with a gap around EVERY REAL cell (active AND power-off): an 'In' stub before the first node, ±5 px gaps around each node, an 'Out' stub to the row's right edge. Batch 3 (item 3, m04252): EMPTY slots (gaps/inserts, isInsert) are SKIPPED in the per-row occupied-cell list, so the line runs CONTINUOUS through them — a gap only shows its dashed add square on hover, on top of the still-visible line (was: empty slots broke the line). Power-off blocks stay in the occupied list: their transparent square lets the line show THROUGH them. The two-row transition is Line 6 stadium style (batch 2, user m02657 — NO snake elbow): row 1's line ends with a 13 px Icon::ArrowRight at the grid's right edge, row 2 starts with a 13 px Icon::ArrowRight at the grid's left edge, both rows flow left→right and row 2 enters its leftmost node. The line is painted before the cells and only when nodeView_ is set (an opaque panel fill before the visibility guard used to cover the inactive gallery view, m03703). A g_dropTarget in range paints a theme::kHighlight border on that cell plus — batch 3 — the dragged effect's icon at 0.5 alpha.

NodeStrip is the selected block's SINGLE-ROW parameter strip docked to the BOTTOM of the view (resized(): stripY = jmax(0, getHeight() - stripH - kStripBottomGap), kStripBottomGap = 16, kStripHeadH = 56; full width). 56 px header: block-kind label in caps over the mode line — context menus: modeB_ (juce::TextButton -> NodeView::openModeMenu(), delay 4 / Compressor 5 / reverb 6 modes, current entry disabled with a leading marker) and typeB_ (-> openTypeMenu(), reverb type list, shown only when Reverb::numTypes(mode) > 1); both build std::vector<ContextMenu::Item> and open centred over the strip via showStripMenu (widgets/ContextMenu, local-coordinate openAtPoint). Batch 3 (5b9bdd9): mode-menu bullets use juce::String::fromUTF8 (a raw char literal the font renderer mis-decoded, item 7) and a mode pick now WRITES the real param (delayMode/compMode/reverbMode via chain.setBlockParam at NodeView.cpp:1083-1087); In/Out knobs are pinned to the noon readout (m04302). Batch-3 knob-scale law (item 4): the Mix knob (and the In/Out gain knobs) are IDENTITY-scaled — pos = raw 0..1, knobFromStored only for non-identity scales (knobFromStored on an identity-stored param slammed Mix to ~0%); onChange is symmetric. Strip visibility (item 1+2): setNodeView(false) hides cells AND strip (strip_->setVisible(false) + clearContent(), NodeView.cpp:496-498); syncStrip() hides the strip when no block is selected (NodeView.cpp:871); the hide_ Icon::X button is shown via updateStripChrome and is the ONLY strip close (hideStrip() clears the selection); the strip stays open while the mouse is inside (knob turns no longer rebuild-and-close it, batch-2 item 9). Per-knob VALUE readout paints persistently above the knob face from KnobScale::format(knobFromStored(*scale, raw)), knob name below (labelOnTop = true); each knob gets setValue(...) after construction (Knob ctor clamps to options.min). Panel: theme::kPanelBg @ 0.55 tinted fill, 10 px radius. Knobs are owned std::vector<Knob*> (created on selection, deleted in clearContent()); onChange writes back through chain.setBlockParam(id, param, knobToStored(...)). Params come from the SHARED paramsFor table in views/gallery/EffectParams.h (tone nodes show only In/Out/Mix trims). Every strip knob is headless-tested by test/src/strip_knob_tests.cpp: 7 StripKnob tests (round-trip + finite readout + numeric readouts ≤4 chars) plus 8 batch-3 StripKnobPosition tests (identity pos==raw, In/Out noon pin, stored→raw round-trips).
